entries.body:
# Life Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- Wings:
  - Insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - Shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- Skin:
  - Soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- Hair:
  - Light, flowing as if weightless  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → silver → elemental tones  

- Eyes:
  - Bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - Colour Range:
    - Matches elemental affinity  

- Hands:
  - Tiny, delicate fingers  
  - Highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- Face:
  - Soft, expressive features  
  - Emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- Ears:
  - Small and pointed  

- Markings:
  - Faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- Body:
  - Extremely lightweight  
  - Movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | :---------: | :--------: | :---------------------: |
| Strength       |     -3      |    2d4     |         Tier 1          |
| Dexterity      |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Agility        |     +2      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Constitution   |     -2      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Endurance      |      0      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Intelligence   |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
## Magical Affinity (Innate)

### Description

Every Pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. This magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

### Effects

- Born with **100% Affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- This affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- Gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- Wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- Unlock the corresponding **Elemental Gift** racial trait.

---

## Trait II — Racial Bond: Split Soul

### Description

A Pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a Sprite. Together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

### Effects

- Every Pixie possesses a spiritually linked **Sprite**.
- Pixie and Sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- The bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- While close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- If the bond is damaged, suppressed or severed, both become **Soul Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the GM.

---

## Trait III — Fey Perception

### Description

Pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of Fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

### Effects

- Naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- Sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- Gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- Gain bonuses when identifying Fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

## Trait IV — Fey Wings

### Description

Pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. They provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

### Effects

- Gain a natural Flight Speed.
- Can hover without requiring forward movement.
- Descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- Wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- Wing appearance permanently reflects the Pixie's elemental affinity.

---

## Trait V — Elemental Gift

### Description

Each Pixie's soul manifests a unique blessing determined by its elemental affinity. This Elemental Gift grants passive abilities reflecting the nature of the magic bound to their soul.

### Effects

- Gain one unique **Elemental Gift** based on your chosen magical affinity.
- The Elemental Gift grants passive bonuses, resistances and magical adaptations unique to that element.
- This trait is permanent and cannot naturally change.
- See **Pixie Elemental Gifts** for individual elemental abilities.

## Traits & Biology
- Flight-based movement (primary mobility)  
- Highly agile, erratic movement pattern  
- Can hover and change direction instantly  

⚠️ Limitations:

- Extremely low strength  
- Reliant on magic and positioning  
- Vulnerable if grounded or restrained  

---

> "Fate doesn’t guide us… it dances with us."

| Wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
## Magical Affinity (Innate)

### Description

Every Pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. This magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

### Effects

- Born with **100% Affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- This affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- Gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- Wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- Unlock the corresponding **Elemental Gift** racial trait.

---

## Trait II — Racial Bond: Split Soul

### Description

A Pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a Sprite. Together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

### Effects

- Every Pixie possesses a spiritually linked **Sprite**.
- Pixie and Sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- The bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- While close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- If the bond is damaged, suppressed or severed, both become **Soul Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the GM.

---

## Trait III — Fey Perception

### Description

Pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of Fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

### Effects

- Naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- Sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- Gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- Gain bonuses when identifying Fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

## Trait IV — Fey Wings

### Description

Pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. They provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

### Effects

- Gain a natural Flight Speed.
- Can hover without requiring forward movement.
- Descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- Wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- Wing appearance permanently reflects the Pixie's elemental affinity.

---

## Trait V — Elemental Gift

### Description

Each Pixie's soul manifests a unique blessing determined by its elemental affinity. This Elemental Gift grants passive abilities reflecting the nature of the magic bound to their soul.

### Effects

- Gain one unique **Elemental Gift** based on your chosen magical affinity.
- The Elemental Gift grants passive bonuses, resistances and magical adaptations unique to that element.
- This trait is permanent and cannot naturally change.
- See **Pixie Elemental Gifts** for individual elemental abilities.

## Lore
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

## Traits & Biology
- Flight-based movement (primary mobility)  
- Highly agile, erratic movement pattern  
- Can hover and change direction instantly  

⚠️ Limitations:
- Vulnerable in strong winds  
- Reduced effectiveness in confined spaces  

---

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Very fragile (low HP potential)  
- Extremely low strength  
- Reliant on magic and positioning  
- Vulnerable if grounded or restrained  

---

> "Fate doesn’t guide us… it dances with us."
— Lirael, Emberwing Pixie
